avis.texte: I love this face wash, I've used it for about 3 months and saw a drastic difference in the birghtness of my skin. Some of my dark marks have faded as well. The gel consistency and foaming is perfect, it will be a permanent staple in my daytime skin care routine.

Seems like a good cleanser (bought it becaue the Vit C body wash is so good) BUT I can't get over the weird smell. One of the resons I like Naturium is because most things are unscented and maybe this is technically unscented but if so, EWWWWWW. Hard to get past. I'll use up the bottle because the product does seem very cleansing and I think it's moderately effective, but might be the first thing from Naturium that I do not repurchase
I want to love this but it has the worst smell! It's so hard to tolerate to use on my fscr.
Best cleaner ever. Not sponsored. I recommend this to everyone. So sad its not in any stores around me.
This cleanser smells so horrible, I only used it once. They need to do something with how it smells.

My face has been screaming for a new cleanser and this one came through. I did a deep clean on my face with a facial scrub pad and my face felt clean, soft and just refreshed. I'll probably do a deep clean once or twice a week to keep my skin feeling clean and refreshed. The smell could definitely be worked on but it it is tolerable for the result it gives. I'd recommend this proand purchase it again.
This is the first time using this cleanser and my skin has been thriving with this and the peptide moisturizer. This is a good daily cleanser for AM/PM that doesn't leave my face feeling dry.

I lean more combo/acne-prone, and this cleanser has very quickly become my new holy grail morning cleanser to gently exfoliate any dead skin cells from my tretinoin the night before while also "clearing the decks" so that I don't risk any clogged pores during the day (I use the Niacinamide Cleansing Gelee at night to focus on hydration without irritating my skin while using tret). The brightening benefits are great (I saw a reduction in dark spots pretty quickly), and my sensitive skin is never left feeling stripped or irritated. If you're looking for a gentle exfoliating cleanser, this is it!
Really makes my face feel clean, but the scent is so unbearable and off-putting I had to stop using it

I love this Vitamin C Complex Cleanser! My skin feels clean yet not stripped of natural oils. Also I have always taken good care of my skin but the highest compliment I received was from my dermatologist! That, my friends says it all. "You have great skin!"
I didn't notice a major change in my skin. I would consider continuing using it, however I just cant get around the smell of the cleanser. It has raw vegetable type of smell.

I use to use another face cleanser until i found "Naturium Vit C Complex Cleanse". This is the best product. I apply it every night to remove my makeup and it works better than any cleanser i have tried. I love how quickly this product removes my makeup with just one time. I plan to keep an extra bottle on hand.

I just purchased tonight and gave it a try. I didn't notice anything special about the way it cleansed…. but this smell! Idk how to describe it other than it reminds me of a wet dog. I think I may have to return this one.
I use Natrium Retinaldehyde daily and use this cleanser as a mask 3 times a week. Its gentle but so effective. Leaves my skin smooth with a nice healthy glow.
On my second bottle of this eye cream. A little goes a long way and doesn't irritate my eyes.
This serum really brightens my face and keeps it looking good
I love the cleanser and the job it does! However, it does have a funky smell to it. Hope they can improve on that.

Got this because a brand rep approached me and our conversation led me to try this out as an upgrade from my go-to. Personally, I have seen good results from my two holy grail face washes and this didnt give that. It made me realize I definitely need a gel cleanser vs cream or oil to clean my skin better. But other than that I won't be repurchasing when done. The smell is also off-putting.

avis.titre: Product is fine, but the smell...
avis.texte: I LOVED the Niacinamide gelee cleanser, so I wanted to try this one out. Overall, not a bad product, the only reason I wouldn't buy it again is the smell! It smells bad in my opinion. I'm still going to use it, but once it's empty, I'm buying the Niacinamide one again.
I love this cleanser. It removes my makeup without having to do a double cleanse. The refreshing formula leaves my sensitive face clean but not feeling overstripped.

avis.titre: Naturium vitamin C products are excellent
avis.texte: I have tried all of Naturium's vitamin C products. I started with the body wash, to serum, now this face wash. All of them are hydrating and give me a glow. Affordable, clean, and works like the high end products.

I want to love this cleanser but the smell makes me want to return it. Its not a fragrance type of smell. It smells badly like baby food. Perhaps I have a bad one? I love the brand overall but not this product.

avis.titre: Andrea Nutrium Rep at Ulta Oceanside CA
avis.texte: I had zero facial skin care routine until fabulous Andrea approached me at Ulta Oceanside CA Location. So patient and gave me a tailored crash course fully relevant to my body. I ended up purchasing 3 Nutrium products. Andrea is knowledgeable.

Definitely a skincare junky & try all different brands. This is a 1st for trying Nutrium. Was going for a La Roche Posay cleanser when I saw this so decided to give a try luckily with no regrets. Will buy again and also would like to try other Nutrium products as well.

avis.titre: Experienced my softest, cleanest skin ever!
avis.texte: I am a skincare enthusiast and brand loyalist, having used some of my favorite skincare brands for decades. Naturium's Glow Getter caught my eye while searching for new bodywash and I haven't looked back. I put this vitamin C cleanser on dry skin, rubbed in and rinsed it off and wow! Not only was my skin SO clean, it was visibly brighter, without any drying effects. Here is a video of me using it, my skin looks like I have a filter on it, I don't. I washed my face for 60 secs and haven't touched my go-to brands since.

I never thought a cleanser could make such a difference but wow. My skin tone is so much more even and brighter since using this. It removes my makeup and spf no problem without stripping my skin or causing breakouts. I love it, it is my go to cleanser now.
I was so excited for this and assumed I would be obsessed, but I cannot get over how bad it smells.
I USE THIS IN THE AM I WISH IT WAS A LITTLE MORE MOISTURIZING BUT I DO LIKE IT. THE NIACINIMIDE GELEE CLEANSER IS MORE MOISTURIZING BUT I REALLY DO LIKE IT

avis.titre: Not as Good as Mixed Greens Cleanser
avis.texte: I bought this as a replacement for the Mixed Greens Nutrient Rich Cleanser (which has been sold out for months). After two weeks I am not seeing improvement in brightness, but it also doesn't seem to cleanse as well as previous Naturium cleansers. This is the first product I am disappointed in purchasing.

Cleans my skin well, even full makeup. It is a little drying though. But I just use my serums and moisturizers after! I feel like my dark spots don't look as deep and that's a big win for me! I have oily/combo skin, deep skin tone, hyperpigmentation and occasional hormonal acne even in my 30s. I would recommend this!

Bought this about 2 weeks ago and I LOVE IT SO MUCH! My skin feels super clean without feeling stripped. I have acne prone oily skin with dark marks from acne and I feel super fresh and glowy with this cleanser. I want to bathe it it's so refreshing. If you like the gelee cleanser you'll love this!!!!! It's my main cleanser AM AND PM forever!
Just Perfection! I love how this cleanser feels on my skin and gives me that glow!! I am obsessed!

I love this cleanser! But honestly, I've loved everything I've gotten from Naturium! But this cleansers great it makes my skin look brighter and it feels clean. It definitely gets all the dirt and grime off my skin. I love Naturium cleansers. They're such a good price and you get so much.
I can't say enough great things about the whole brand, my absolute favorite products!

Only had this cleanser for a week but can already see a nice glow to my skin. I've used the other Gel cleanser which I love also for about a year. But this is definitely my new favorite. Will purchase this again as a routine staple in my skin care regimen.
Love it! Ive been consistent using it and I can see a huge difference in my skin. Not only on my dark spots but also on my skin texture.
